newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan Q2 may be beneath consensus - analyst.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan Q2 may be beneath consensus - analyst.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc might miss the second-quarter consensus forecast of earnings of $1.95 per share by $0.20-$0.25, analyst George Salem of Gerard Klauer Mattison said Wednesday.
J.P. Morgan declined comment. A spokesman said the company does not comment on earnings estimates.

The second-quarter consensus view in the First Call system is $1.95 per share. Salem said J.P. Morgan has been talking to Wall Street analysts but not making a specific forecast about the earnings for the quarter.
J.P. Morgan was off 1-1/2 to 110 late Wednesday.
